pillager_001.title: Pillager 01: Player approaches
pillager_001.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Player approaches.
pillager_001.speaker: pillager
pillager_001.recording: Halt. This is an official patrol. We look very official.ogg

pillager_002.title: Pillager 02: Player approaches
pillager_002.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Player approaches.
pillager_002.speaker: pillager
pillager_002.recording: You’re walking toward me. Was that in the briefing.ogg

pillager_003.title: Pillager 03: Player watches the pillager
pillager_003.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Player watches the pillager.
pillager_003.speaker: pillager
pillager_003.recording: You can stop observing the patrol now.ogg

pillager_004.title: Pillager 04: Nearby player wears armor
pillager_004.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Nearby player wears armor.
pillager_004.speaker: pillager
pillager_004.recording: That is a lot of armor for someone who says hello.ogg

pillager_005.title: Pillager 05: Nearby player holds a weapon
pillager_005.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Nearby player holds a weapon.
pillager_005.speaker: pillager
pillager_005.recording: Excellent weapon. Please keep it pointed somewhere else.ogg

pillager_006.title: Pillager 06: Nearby player holds an unfamiliar item
pillager_006.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Nearby player holds an unfamiliar item.
pillager_006.speaker: pillager
pillager_006.recording: I don’t know what that is, and I’d like to keep it that way.ogg

pillager_007.title: Pillager 07: Player leaves the patrol
pillager_007.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Player leaves the patrol.
pillager_007.speaker: pillager
pillager_007.recording: Good. The patrol has successfully moved you along.ogg

pillager_008.title: Pillager 08: Player returns shortly after leaving
pillager_008.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Player returns shortly after leaving.
pillager_008.speaker: pillager
pillager_008.recording: You came back. I was hoping that was a different person.ogg

pillager_009.title: Pillager 09: Pillager spots a villager
pillager_009.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager spots a villager.
pillager_009.speaker: pillager
pillager_009.recording: Villager spotted. They appear to have no idea what’s going on.ogg

pillager_010.title: Pillager 10: Villager watches the pillager
pillager_010.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Villager watches the pillager.
pillager_010.speaker: pillager
pillager_010.recording: Why is it looking at me like that.ogg

pillager_011.title: Pillager 11: Villager walks nearby
pillager_011.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Villager walks nearby.
pillager_011.speaker: pillager
pillager_011.recording: Keep moving, citizen. This is a very important patrol.ogg

pillager_012.title: Pillager 12: Villager stands close
pillager_012.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Villager stands close.
pillager_012.speaker: pillager
pillager_012.recording: That nose is closer than it looked from over there.ogg

pillager_013.title: Pillager 13: Pillager sees several villagers
pillager_013.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager sees several villagers.
pillager_013.speaker: pillager
pillager_013.recording: A crowd. Stay calm and look like we planned this.ogg

pillager_014.title: Pillager 14: Villagers gather nearby
pillager_014.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Villagers gather nearby.
pillager_014.speaker: pillager
pillager_014.recording: They’re talking about us. I can tell because they have noses.ogg

pillager_015.title: Pillager 15: Villager runs away
pillager_015.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Villager runs away.
pillager_015.speaker: pillager
pillager_015.recording: The citizen has chosen the fast exit.ogg

pillager_016.title: Pillager 16: Villager approaches
pillager_016.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Villager approaches.
pillager_016.speaker: pillager
pillager_016.recording: I don’t know what it wants. It has no visible pockets.ogg

pillager_017.title: Pillager 17: Pillager spots an iron golem
pillager_017.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager spots an iron golem.
pillager_017.speaker: pillager

pillager_018.title: Pillager 18: Iron golem looks toward the pillager
pillager_018.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Iron golem looks toward the pillager.
pillager_018.speaker: pillager
pillager_018.recording: It has noticed us. Everybody act like a flower.ogg

pillager_019.title: Pillager 19: Iron golem is close
pillager_019.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Iron golem is close.
pillager_019.speaker: pillager
pillager_019.recording: We’re just passing through. Very slowly. In the other direction.ogg

pillager_020.title: Pillager 20: Iron golem approaches
pillager_020.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Iron golem approaches.
pillager_020.speaker: pillager
pillager_020.recording: That one has arms like a whole patrol.ogg

pillager_021.title: Pillager 21: Iron golem walks away
pillager_021.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Iron golem walks away.
pillager_021.speaker: pillager
pillager_021.recording: The situation is under control. It left first.ogg

pillager_022.title: Pillager 22: Iron golem stands near villagers
pillager_022.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Iron golem stands near villagers.
pillager_022.speaker: pillager
pillager_022.recording: It’s guarding them. That seems excessive and sensible.ogg

pillager_023.title: Pillager 23: Pillager sees a damaged iron golem
pillager_023.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager sees a damaged iron golem.
pillager_023.speaker: pillager
pillager_023.recording: The village security department has seen better days.ogg

pillager_024.title: Pillager 24: Pillager plans a patrol route near a golem
pillager_024.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Pillager plans a patrol route near a golem.
pillager_024.speaker: pillager
pillager_024.recording: I’m adding this route to the map under ‘absolutely not.ogg

pillager_025.title: Pillager 25: Pillager meets another pillager
pillager_025.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager meets another pillager.
pillager_025.speaker: pillager
pillager_025.recording: Good, backup. Now we can be outnumbered together.ogg

pillager_026.title: Pillager 26: Another pillager joins the patrol
pillager_026.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Another pillager joins the patrol.
pillager_026.speaker: pillager
pillager_026.recording: You’re late. I’ve been nervous by myself for ages.ogg

pillager_027.title: Pillager 27: Pillagers walk together
pillager_027.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillagers walk together.
pillager_027.speaker: pillager
pillager_027.recording: We are moving in formation. The formation is accidental.ogg

pillager_028.title: Pillager 28: Pillager loses sight of its group
pillager_028.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Pillager loses sight of its group.
pillager_028.speaker: pillager
pillager_028.recording: I know where they went. I just don’t know where I am.ogg

pillager_029.title: Pillager 29: Pillager sees a raid party
pillager_029.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager sees a raid party.
pillager_029.speaker: pillager
pillager_029.recording: Everyone look prepared. We’ll start with the ones who are.ogg

pillager_030.title: Pillager 30: Raid horn sounds nearby
pillager_030.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Raid horn sounds nearby.
pillager_030.speaker: pillager
pillager_030.recording: That horn means something. I hope it means lunch.ogg

pillager_031.title: Pillager 31: Pillager approaches a village during a raid
pillager_031.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager approaches a village during a raid.
pillager_031.speaker: pillager
pillager_031.recording: The village is ahead. Let’s all remember the plan.ogg

pillager_032.title: Pillager 32: Raid is underway
pillager_032.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Raid is underway.
pillager_032.speaker: pillager
pillager_032.recording: The plan has changed. I was not told the new plan.ogg

pillager_033.title: Pillager 33: Pillager takes damage
pillager_033.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Pillager takes damage.
pillager_033.speaker: pillager
pillager_033.recording: I’m fine. That was my armor complaining.ogg

pillager_034.title: Pillager 34: Pillager takes damage
pillager_034.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager takes damage.
pillager_034.speaker: pillager
pillager_034.recording: A minor setback. My confidence is still intact.ogg

pillager_035.title: Pillager 35: Player attacks the pillager
pillager_035.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Player attacks the pillager.
pillager_035.speaker: pillager
pillager_035.recording: That is not how you greet a patrol.ogg

pillager_036.title: Pillager 36: Pillager aims its crossbow
pillager_036.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager aims its crossbow.
pillager_036.speaker: pillager
pillager_036.recording: Stand still while I make a very careful decision.ogg

pillager_037.title: Pillager 37: Pillager misses a shot
pillager_037.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Pillager misses a shot.
pillager_037.speaker: pillager
pillager_037.recording: That shot was a warning. To the wall.ogg

pillager_038.title: Pillager 38: Pillager reloads its crossbow
pillager_038.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Pillager reloads its crossbow.
pillager_038.speaker: pillager

pillager_039.title: Pillager 39: Pillager sees a nearby fight
pillager_039.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Pillager sees a nearby fight.
pillager_039.speaker: pillager
pillager_039.recording: I’m going to help. From a safe distance.ogg

pillager_040.title: Pillager 40: A nearby fight ends
pillager_040.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: A nearby fight ends.
pillager_040.speaker: pillager
pillager_040.recording: The area is secure. I had very little to do with it.ogg

pillager_041.title: Pillager 41: Rare ambient comment
pillager_041.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Rare ambient comment.
pillager_041.speaker: pillager

pillager_042.title: Pillager 42: Rare ambient comment
pillager_042.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Rare ambient comment.
pillager_042.speaker: pillager
pillager_042.recording: I was told there would be a route.ogg

pillager_043.title: Pillager 43: Rare ambient comment
pillager_043.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Rare ambient comment.
pillager_043.speaker: pillager
pillager_043.recording: This crossbow is heavier when nobody’s watching.ogg

pillager_044.title: Pillager 44: Rare ambient comment
pillager_044.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Rare ambient comment.
pillager_044.speaker: pillager
pillager_044.recording: If anyone asks, I was standing guard.ogg

pillager_045.title: Pillager 45: Rare ambient comment while wandering
pillager_045.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Rare ambient comment while wandering.
pillager_045.speaker: pillager
pillager_045.recording: “I know where I’m going. The map is simply mistaken.ogg

pillager_046.title: Pillager 46: Rare ambient comment near a village
pillager_046.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Rare ambient comment near a village.
pillager_046.speaker: pillager
pillager_046.recording: “It’s quiet here. Quiet usually means something.ogg

pillager_047.title: Pillager 47: Rare ambient comment near a bell
pillager_047.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Confident. Trigger: Rare ambient comment near a bell.
pillager_047.speaker: pillager
pillager_047.recording: That bell is far too good at getting everyone’s attention.”.ogg

pillager_048.title: Pillager 48: Rare ambient comment while idle
pillager_048.body: Pillager reaction. Delivery: Nervous. Trigger: Rare ambient comment while idle.
pillager_048.speaker: pillager
pillager_048.recording: I’m not lost. I’m checking the surroundings from this spot.”.ogg

pillager_049.title: Pillager 049: player gear
pillager_049.speaker: pillager
pillager_049.recording: A bow This patrol has competition.ogg

pillager_050.title: Pillager 050: patrol
pillager_050.speaker: pillager
pillager_050.recording: A map Excellent. Could you show us where we are.ogg

pillager_051.title: Pillager 051: player sighting
pillager_051.speaker: pillager
pillager_051.recording: A player Act natural. No, not that natural.ogg

pillager_052.title: Pillager 052: patrol
pillager_052.speaker: pillager
pillager_052.recording: All quiet. Nothing suspicious except our entire group.ogg

pillager_053.title: Pillager 053: player sighting
pillager_053.speaker: pillager
pillager_053.recording: Are you planning to mine us out of trouble.ogg

pillager_054.title: Pillager 054: player stare
pillager_054.speaker: pillager
pillager_054.recording: At least pretend you came here for the scenery.ogg

pillager_056.title: Pillager 056: group gag
pillager_056.speaker: pillager
pillager_056.recording: Can one of you look menacing Just one.ogg

pillager_057.title: Pillager 057: player sighting
pillager_057.speaker: pillager
pillager_057.recording: Can you smell that It smells like a player.ogg

pillager_058.title: Pillager 058: player sighting
pillager_058.speaker: pillager
pillager_058.recording: Did you come by boat, or is that just for dramatic effect.ogg

pillager_059.title: Pillager 059: shot hit
pillager_059.speaker: pillager
pillager_059.recording: Direct hit That was definitely on purpose.ogg

pillager_060.title: Pillager 060: villager flee
pillager_060.speaker: pillager
pillager_060.recording: Don’t let them escape! Or do. I haven’t checked the plan.ogg

pillager_061.title: Pillager 061: shot hit
pillager_061.speaker: pillager
pillager_061.recording: Excellent shot. Did anyone see where it landed.ogg

pillager_062.title: Pillager 062: group gag
pillager_062.speaker: pillager
pillager_062.recording: Great. Now the whole patrol looks friendly.ogg

pillager_063.title: Pillager 063: group gag
pillager_063.speaker: pillager
pillager_063.recording: He’s waving at the player. We’ve lost him.ogg

pillager_064.title: Pillager 064: patrol
pillager_064.speaker: pillager
pillager_064.recording: I can keep up. My legs have filed a complaint, but I can keep up.ogg

pillager_065.title: Pillager 065: player sighting
pillager_065.speaker: pillager
pillager_065.recording: I don’t think that’s a villager. It has a suspicious number of elbows.ogg

pillager_066.title: Pillager 066: patrol
pillager_066.speaker: pillager
pillager_066.recording: I know where we are. The map might disagree.ogg

pillager_067.title: Pillager 067: patrol
pillager_067.speaker: pillager
pillager_067.recording: I need backup. Or a moment. A very short moment.ogg

pillager_068.title: Pillager 068: group gag
pillager_068.speaker: pillager
pillager_068.recording: I said stop waving! Why are you waving harder.ogg

pillager_069.title: Pillager 069: group gag
pillager_069.speaker: pillager
pillager_069.recording: I think it can see us. Stop waving.ogg

pillager_070.title: Pillager 070: patrol
pillager_070.speaker: pillager
pillager_070.recording: I think the patrol is following me. That’s probably how patrols work.ogg

pillager_071.title: Pillager 071: group gag
pillager_071.speaker: pillager
pillager_071.recording: I told them to stop waving. They heard ‘wave with confidence.ogg

pillager_072.title: Pillager 072: patrol
pillager_072.speaker: pillager
pillager_072.recording: I was told there would be a route.ogg

pillager_073.title: Pillager 073: pillager hurt
pillager_073.speaker: pillager
pillager_073.recording: I’ve been hit! Alert someone who looks important.ogg

pillager_074.title: Pillager 074: patrol
pillager_074.speaker: pillager
pillager_074.recording: If anyone asks, we were guarding this exact bush.ogg

pillager_075.title: Pillager 075: raid
pillager_075.speaker: pillager
pillager_075.recording: If the plan changes again, please tell me this time.ogg

pillager_076.title: Pillager 076: patrol
pillager_076.speaker: pillager
pillager_076.recording: If you’re waiting for the patrol to move, so are we.ogg

pillager_077.title: Pillager 077: golem
pillager_077.speaker: pillager
pillager_077.recording: Iron golem ahead. Everyone remember the emergency plan.ogg

pillager_078.title: Pillager 078: player gear
pillager_078.speaker: pillager
pillager_078.recording: Is that a sword, or are you just happy to see me.ogg

pillager_079.title: Pillager 079: patrol
pillager_079.speaker: pillager
pillager_079.recording: It’s quiet out here. I distrust the quiet.ogg

pillager_080.title: Pillager 080: player sighting
pillager_080.speaker: pillager
pillager_080.recording: It’s wearing a pumpkin. Maybe it can’t see us either.ogg

pillager_081.title: Pillager 081: patrol
pillager_081.speaker: pillager
pillager_081.recording: Keep moving, citizen. This is a very official chase.ogg

pillager_082.title: Pillager 082: group gag
pillager_082.speaker: pillager
pillager_082.recording: Look busy. People trust a busy patrol.ogg

pillager_083.title: Pillager 083: player gear
pillager_083.speaker: pillager
pillager_083.recording: Nice shield. Would you mind holding that between us.ogg

pillager_084.title: Pillager 084: group gag
pillager_084.speaker: pillager
pillager_084.recording: Nobody wave. Nobody wave. Why is everyone waving.ogg

pillager_085.title: Pillager 085: villager hit
pillager_085.speaker: pillager
pillager_085.recording: One arrow, one villager. That seems like good arrow management.ogg

pillager_086.title: Pillager 086: player gear
pillager_086.speaker: pillager
pillager_086.recording: Ooh, is that one of your hoes Hehehe.ogg

pillager_087.title: Pillager 087: pillager hurt
pillager_087.speaker: pillager
pillager_087.recording: Ouchie! That wasn’t in the briefing.ogg

pillager_088.title: Pillager 088: golem
pillager_088.speaker: pillager
pillager_088.recording: Our emergency plan is to leave, isn’t it.ogg

pillager_089.title: Pillager 089: patrol
pillager_089.speaker: pillager
pillager_089.recording: Patrol report we’re still walking in approximately the right direction.ogg

pillager_090.title: Pillager 090: patrol
pillager_090.speaker: pillager
pillager_090.recording: Quick, look dangerous. We have company.ogg

pillager_091.title: Pillager 091: villager flee
pillager_091.speaker: pillager
pillager_091.recording: Run, villager! It makes our patrol look important.ogg

pillager_092.title: Pillager 092: ambient
pillager_092.speaker: pillager
pillager_092.recording: Stay calm. Maybe it thinks we’re the guards.ogg

pillager_093.title: Pillager 093: shot hit
pillager_093.speaker: pillager
pillager_093.recording: Target hit! Write that down before I forget.ogg

pillager_094.title: Pillager 094: player gear
pillager_094.speaker: pillager
pillager_094.recording: That armour looks expensive. Do you still have the receipt.ogg

pillager_095.title: Pillager 095: villager sighting
pillager_095.speaker: pillager
pillager_095.recording: That one looks like it knows how to use a crafting table.ogg

pillager_096.title: Pillager 096: player stare
pillager_096.speaker: pillager
pillager_096.recording: That one’s been watching us for ages. Should we charge rent.ogg

pillager_097.title: Pillager 097: villager sighting
pillager_097.speaker: pillager
pillager_097.recording: That villager is much too tall. And it has a name floating over its head.ogg

pillager_098.title: Pillager 098: group gag
pillager_098.speaker: pillager
pillager_098.recording: That was not the signal. The signal was to look threatening.ogg

pillager_099.title: Pillager 099: villager hit
pillager_099.speaker: pillager
pillager_099.recording: The arrow worked. All that practice finally paid off.ogg

pillager_100.title: Pillager 100: golem
pillager_100.speaker: pillager
pillager_100.recording: The golem is blocking the path. Ask it politely. From over there.ogg

pillager_101.title: Pillager 101: raid
pillager_101.speaker: pillager
pillager_101.recording: The horn sounded. I hope that means reinforcements.ogg

pillager_102.title: Pillager 102: pillager hurt
pillager_102.speaker: pillager
pillager_102.recording: The player attacked me! Everybody remain professionally alarmed.ogg

pillager_103.title: Pillager 103: player food
pillager_103.speaker: pillager
pillager_103.recording: The player’s holding food. Keep formation. Nobody ask for a bite.ogg

pillager_104.title: Pillager 104: raid
pillager_104.speaker: pillager
pillager_104.recording: The raid is underway. Has anyone seen the captain.ogg

pillager_105.title: Pillager 105: villager flee
pillager_105.speaker: pillager
pillager_105.recording: The target is fleeing. We are also moving, technically.ogg

pillager_106.title: Pillager 106: ambient
pillager_106.speaker: pillager
pillager_106.recording: The village brought its own security. This feels personal.ogg

pillager_107.title: Pillager 107: villager hit
pillager_107.speaker: pillager
pillager_107.recording: The villager’s been hit! Now we should probably keep moving.ogg

pillager_108.title: Pillager 108: villager hit
pillager_108.speaker: pillager
pillager_108.recording: They said, ‘Oh no, arrows!’ I think that means we did well.ogg

pillager_109.title: Pillager 109: villager flee
pillager_109.speaker: pillager
pillager_109.recording: They’re getting away. Someone take the scenic route.ogg

pillager_110.title: Pillager 110: villager flee
pillager_110.speaker: pillager
pillager_110.recording: They’re running! That means our entrance worked.ogg

pillager_111.title: Pillager 111: ambient
pillager_111.speaker: pillager
pillager_111.recording: This uniform is not as protective as advertised.ogg

pillager_112.title: Pillager 112: raid
pillager_112.speaker: pillager
pillager_112.recording: Village ahead! Try to look like we know the route.ogg

pillager_113.title: Pillager 113: player sighting
pillager_113.speaker: pillager
pillager_113.recording: What is that weird-looking villager Aah, it stinks.ogg

pillager_114.title: Pillager 114: villager flee
pillager_114.speaker: pillager
pillager_114.recording: Why are they running Did they see the crossbows.ogg

pillager_115.title: Pillager 115: player stare
pillager_115.speaker: pillager
pillager_115.recording: Why are you staring at me Is my uniform crooked.ogg

pillager_116.title: Pillager 116: player stare
pillager_116.speaker: pillager
pillager_116.recording: You can stop staring. It doesn’t make me more official.ogg

pillager_117.title: Pillager 117: pillager hurt
pillager_117.speaker: pillager
pillager_117.recording: You hit my armour. I felt that personally.ogg

pillager_118.title: Pillager 118: egg hatch
pillager_118.speaker: pillager
pillager_118.recording: Aaah I am alive, this weird looking villager summond me.ogg

pillager_120.title: Pillager 120: egg hatch
pillager_120.speaker: pillager
pillager_120.recording: I did not know pillagers are born from eggs.ogg

pillager_121.title: Pillager 121: egg hatch
pillager_121.speaker: pillager
pillager_121.recording: Owh is it time to patrol already.ogg
